# Component catalogue

Reviewed 2026-10-16: [Web Awesome reference catalogue](https://webawesome.com/docs/components). 90 reference entries and 11 existing UI primitives.

Scope mapping, not feature parity. native means a platform recipe; foundation means an existing UI primitive or adapter; planned means unimplemented. No entry is a certified accessibility claim. Proposed names may change.

Delivery phases and the stable-release gate are in [ROADMAP.md](../ROADMAP.md). Examples are minimal structures, not complete applications. Native/foundation entries still need the listed release evidence. Proposed widgets have contracts instead of pretend live demos.

## Existing UI primitives

### ui-stack

**Foundation · CSS-only.** Vertical rhythm for direct children. Default geometry follows comfortable/compact data-density scopes; local component overrides still win. See docs/density.md.

```html
<ui-stack><h2>Projects</h2><p>Your current work.</p></ui-stack>
```

[Current API](reference.md)

### ui-cluster

**Foundation · CSS-only.** Wrapping row of native controls or content. Default geometry follows comfortable/compact data-density scopes; local component overrides still win. See docs/density.md.

```html
<ui-cluster><button type="button">Save</button><a href="/projects">Cancel</a></ui-cluster>
```

[Current API](reference.md)

### ui-grid

**Foundation · CSS-only.** Responsive equal tracks without grid semantics. Default geometry follows comfortable/compact data-density scopes; local component overrides still win. See docs/density.md.

```html
<ui-grid><section><h2>First</h2></section><section><h2>Second</h2></section></ui-grid>
```

[Current API](reference.md)

### ui-sidebar

**Foundation · CSS-only.** Two direct children: sidebar first, content second. Default geometry follows comfortable/compact data-density scopes; local component overrides still win. See docs/density.md.

```html
<ui-sidebar><aside>Related content</aside><section><h2>Main content</h2></section></ui-sidebar>
```

[Current API](reference.md)

### ui-panel

**Foundation · CSS-only.** Surface/padding without a landmark or interactive role. Default geometry follows comfortable/compact data-density scopes; local component overrides still win. See docs/density.md.

```html
<ui-panel><article><h2>Project</h2><p>Summary.</p></article></ui-panel>
```

[Current API](reference.md)

### ui-field

**Foundation · CSS-only.** One native control plus label, hints and error.

```html
<ui-field><label for="title">Title</label><input id="title" name="title"></ui-field>
```

[Current API](reference.md)

### ui-hint

**Foundation · CSS-only.** Supplemental text, explicitly associated for no-JS use.

```html
<ui-hint id="title-hint">Use a short name.</ui-hint>
<input aria-label="Title" aria-describedby="title-hint" name="title">
```

[Current API](reference.md)

### ui-error

**Foundation · CSS-only.** Inline text, associated when an error is present.

```html
<ui-error id="title-error">Error: Enter a title</ui-error>
<input aria-label="Title" name="title" aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="title-error">
```

[Current API](reference.md)

### ui-error-summary

**Foundation · Optional JS.** Named summary with field links and focus behavior.

```html
<ui-error-summary hidden><h2>There is a problem</h2><ul></ul></ui-error-summary>
```

[Current API](reference.md)

### ui-form

**Foundation · Optional JS.** Wrap exactly one native form; coordinate validation and recovery. Adopt visible server field errors without moving focus. Observe native external/dynamic ownership; support grouped feedback and application-supplied prefixes/message translations. Async transport remains application-owned; see docs/forms.md.

```html
<ui-form><form action="/projects" method="post"><label for="title">Title</label><input id="title" name="title" required><button>Save</button></form></ui-form>
```

[Current API](reference.md)

### ui-skip-link

**Foundation · CSS-only.** Native skip anchor with visible focused presentation.

```html
<ui-skip-link><a href="#main">Skip to main content</a></ui-skip-link>
<main id="main" tabindex="-1"><h1>Projects</h1></main>
```

[Current API](reference.md)

## Actions

### Button

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `button; a[href]`.

Use buttons for actions and anchors for navigation; preserve submit, disabled, and accessible names. Native buttons support data-variant primary/secondary/quiet/danger and data-size small/default/large; anchors keep link styling.

**Acceptance work:** Enter/Space, focus, submitter, loading feedback, and disabled behavior.

```html
<button type="submit">Save project</button>
<button type="reset" data-variant="secondary">Reset answers</button>
<button type="button" data-variant="quiet" data-size="small">Clear filters</button>
<a href="/projects">View projects</a>
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/button/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Button Group

**Foundation · Phase 1.** UI route: `ui-cluster with native buttons`.

Group related actions; use a labelled group when context needs it. A cluster is not an ARIA toolbar.

**Acceptance work:** Wrapping, long labels, independent Tab stops; add roving focus only in a separately specified toolbar.

```html
<ui-cluster role="group" aria-label="Project actions">
  <button type="submit">Save project</button>
  <a href="/projects">Cancel</a>
</ui-cluster>
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/button-group/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Copy Button

**Planned · Phase 2.** UI route: `ui-copy with button (proposed)`.

Copy an explicit source on user activation; retain selectable source text and visible feedback.

**Acceptance work:** Clipboard denial, secure-context availability, repeated activation, and polite success/failure announcements.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/copy-button/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Dropdown

**Planned · Phase 2.** UI route: `ui-menu with native button trigger (proposed)`.

Separate navigation disclosures from command menus. Only enhanced command lists receive menu roles.

**Acceptance work:** Arrows, Home/End, typeahead, Escape, focus return, outside dismissal, and nested ownership.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/dropdown/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Dropdown Item

**Planned · Phase 2.** UI route: `button or a inside ui-menu (proposed)`.

Keep native actions and destinations; define checkable items and submenu ownership before adding them.

**Acceptance work:** Disabled items, checked state, activation, and focus after item removal.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/dropdown-item/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

## Forms

### Checkbox

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `input[type=checkbox]`.

Keep label, name, value, checked, required, and disabled on the native input.

**Acceptance work:** Space toggles; indeterminate is separate from checked; field errors remain associated.

```html
<label><input type="checkbox" name="updates" value="yes"> Email updates</label>
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/checkbox/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Checkbox Group

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `fieldset and legend`.

Use a fieldset for a shared question and native checkboxes for independent values.

**Acceptance work:** Legend announcement, group hint/error association; group minimum-count rules require application validation.

```html
<fieldset>
  <legend>Formats</legend>
  <label><input type="checkbox" name="format" value="pdf"> PDF</label>
  <label><input type="checkbox" name="format" value="html"> HTML</label>
</fieldset>
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/checkbox-group/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Color Picker

**Planned · Phase 3.** UI route: `ui-color-picker around input[type=color] (proposed)`.

Retain native color input as baseline; richer swatches and text formats are an enhancement.

**Acceptance work:** Keyboard swatches, explicit color values, alpha/format rules, invalid text, and non-color cues.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/color-picker/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Combobox

**Planned · Phase 3.** UI route: `ui-combobox with native input (proposed)`.

Start with single selection, explicit filtering rules, and a native successful form control.

**Acceptance work:** APG keyboard model, active descendant, IME composition, no results, async races, and reset.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/combobox/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Date Input

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `input[type=date]`.

Use native ISO form values and browser date entry. A custom segmented editor is a later enhancement.

**Acceptance work:** Locale display, min/max, optional empty values, invalid partial entry, and reset; no custom segment parity claimed.

```html
<label for="date">Target date</label>
<input id="date" name="date" type="date">
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/date-input/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Date Picker

**Planned · Phase 3.** UI route: `ui-date-picker (proposed)`.

Calendar enhancement uses an existing date input as value owner; single date precedes ranges.

**Acceptance work:** Calendar keyboard navigation, month/year announcements, unavailable days, locale, and focus return.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/date-picker/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### File Input

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `input[type=file]`.

Keep the native picker, label, multiple/accept hints, and application upload lifecycle.

**Acceptance work:** Keyboard selection, cancellation, validation, selected-file feedback, and upload failure; accept is not server validation.

```html
<label for="attachment">Attachment</label>
<input id="attachment" name="attachment" type="file">
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/file-input/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Input

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `input inside ui-field`.

Use the correct native type, autocomplete, inputmode, label, and name. Optional data-size small/default/large selects CSS geometry; native size semantics and form ownership remain unchanged.

**Acceptance work:** Autofill, native validation, descriptions, read-only/disabled, reset, and mobile keyboard.

```html
<ui-field>
  <label for="email">Email</label>
  <input id="email" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" required>
</ui-field>
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/input/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Known Date

**Planned · Phase 3.** UI route: `ui-date-fields with fieldset (proposed)`.

Compose day, month, and year inputs for dates users know; preserve a labelled group and server parsing.

**Acceptance work:** Locale order, leap days, partial values, numeric entry, grouped errors, and autofill.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/known-date/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Number Input

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `input[type=number]`.

Use for quantities, retaining native min/max/step; identifiers remain text inputs.

**Acceptance work:** Keyboard stepping, decimals, invalid entry, wheel interaction, labels, and reset.

```html
<label for="quantity">Quantity</label>
<input id="quantity" name="quantity" type="number" min="1" step="1" value="1">
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/number-input/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### OTP Input

**Planned · Phase 3.** UI route: `ui-otp with one text input (proposed)`.

Default to one input with autocomplete=one-time-code; visual segments must not fragment entry.

**Acceptance work:** Paste, autofill, leading zeroes, backspace, mobile input, and no forced submission.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/otp-input/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Radio Group

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `fieldset and legend`.

Group same-name native radios; ui-form coordinates a single required-group error.

**Acceptance work:** Arrow navigation, shared name, legend, required state, disabled choices, and reset.

```html
<fieldset>
  <legend>Visibility</legend>
  <label><input type="radio" name="visibility" value="private" checked> Private</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="visibility" value="team"> Team</label>
</fieldset>
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/radio-group/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Radio

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `input[type=radio]`.

A choice is a native radio with an explicit label and stable value.

**Acceptance work:** Checked/unchecked state, label activation, group membership, and accessible name.

```html
<label><input type="radio" name="stage" value="planning"> Planning</label>
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/radio/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Rating

**Planned · Phase 3.** UI route: `ui-rating with native radios (proposed)`.

Use a labelled radio scale for input and readable text for a display-only rating.

**Acceptance work:** Keyboard choice, clear/unrated state, numeric text, disabled/read-only, and form reset.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/rating/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Select

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `select`.

Native options remain the default; searchable choices belong to the separate combobox contract. Optional data-size small/default/large selects CSS geometry; native size semantics and form ownership remain unchanged.

**Acceptance work:** Arrow/typing behavior, multiple selection, placeholder validity, padding, zoom, and forced colors.

```html
<label for="stage">Stage</label>
<select id="stage" name="stage">
  <option value="planning">Planning</option>
  <option value="active">Active</option>
</select>
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/select/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Option

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `option and optgroup`.

Use native children of select; do not place custom elements inside a traditional select.

**Acceptance work:** Disabled options, selected state, group labels, value serialization, and reset.

```html
<select aria-label="Stage" name="stage">
  <optgroup label="Current"><option value="active">Active</option></optgroup>
</select>
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/option/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Slider

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `input[type=range]`.

Supply a label, range constraints, and a textual value with units; do not infer a value announcement from position.

**Acceptance work:** Arrow/step interaction, min/max, accessible value text, touch, and reset.

```html
<label for="volume">Volume, percent</label>
<input id="volume" name="volume" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="50">
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/slider/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Switch

**Planned · Phase 2.** UI route: `ui-switch with native checkbox (proposed)`.

Use only for an immediate binary setting; retain the successful native checkbox and a stable label.

**Acceptance work:** Space, role/state consistency, pending/failure rollback, and distinction from a submitted checkbox.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/switch/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Tag Input

**Planned · Phase 3.** UI route: `ui-tag-input with native input (proposed)`.

Define repeated native form values and removable tokens; baseline accepts a documented text format.

**Acceptance work:** IME, delimiters, duplicates, keyboard removal, accessible removal names, and reset.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/tag-input/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Textarea

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `textarea inside ui-field`.

Preserve native multiline editing, resize, name, maxlength, and associated descriptions. Optional data-size small/default/large selects CSS geometry; native size semantics and form ownership remain unchanged.

**Acceptance work:** Newlines, paste, zoom, error recovery, read-only, disabled, and reset.

```html
<label for="notes">Notes</label>
<textarea id="notes" name="notes" rows="4"></textarea>
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/textarea/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Time Input

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `input[type=time]`.

Use native normalized form values; locale formatting stays with the browser initially.

**Acceptance work:** Seconds/step, min/max, optional emptiness, mobile entry, and server timezone policy.

```html
<label for="time">Start time</label>
<input id="time" name="time" type="time">
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/time-input/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

## Layout

### Accordion

**Foundation · Phase 2.** UI route: `ui-accordion with native details`.

Native disclosures own expansion and optional name-group exclusivity. Shared enhancement opts in by the ui-accordion element name without a data-ui marker and adds summary navigation, fragment reveal and collapsed-content focus recovery.

**Acceptance work:** Native summary activation; optional summary navigation; native name-group boundaries; deep-link and form-error reveal; collapsed-content focus; nested and dynamic teardown. See the proposal's evidence matrix.

[Accordion guide](accordion.md) · [Specification](specs/accordion.md) · [Focused checks](../tests/accordion.html). Experimental; manual platform and assistive-technology evidence remains open.

[Component specification](specs/accordion.md)

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/accordion/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Accordion Item

**Foundation · Phase 2.** UI route: `details and summary inside ui-accordion`.

The native details/summary is the item. Preserve open state, content semantics and native form ownership; no item registration or replacement button.

**Acceptance work:** Native accessible summary/open state, optional heading exposure, content controls and form ownership, programmatic collapse focus recovery, late/replaced summaries and nested groups.

[Accordion guide](accordion.md) · [Specification](specs/accordion.md) · [Focused checks](../tests/accordion.html). Experimental; manual platform and assistive-technology evidence remains open.

[Component specification](specs/accordion.md)

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/accordion-item/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Card

**Foundation · Phase 1.** UI route: `ui-panel containing article/section`.

A panel supplies a surface; native children supply meaning. Explicit links and buttons remain separate.

**Acceptance work:** Heading structure, repeated link names, focus, long content; no clickable-card nesting traps.

```html
<ui-panel>
  <article><h2>Project</h2><p>Project summary.</p><a href="/projects/1">View project</a></article>
</ui-panel>
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/card/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Details

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `details and summary`.

Use the browser disclosure for optional content; closed content must not contain required instructions.

**Acceptance work:** Enter/Space, open state, link targets, print policy, and nested disclosure behavior.

```html
<details>
  <summary>More about this project</summary>
  <p>Supporting information.</p>
</details>
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/details/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Dialog

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `dialog with showModal()`.

Use an accessible title, explicit close action and browser modal behavior. Application code opens it, clears stale results and retains inline information when enhancement is unavailable. Long structured content starts with heading focus and scrolls as one native surface. See docs/dialog.md and its long-briefing recipe. Standard setup is available through js/ui.js and explicit data-ui markup; see docs/enhancement.md.

**Acceptance work:** Browser assertions cover short/long modal focus, scroll bounds, both close actions, reopening at the start, background focus blocking, close results, return focus after trigger changes and unsupported/open-failure/no-script fallback. Verify remaining browser/mobile, zoom, forced colors, touch and screen-reader combinations before release; see dated manual evidence in ACCESSIBILITY.md.

```html
<button id="open-information" type="button" hidden>Open information</button>
<section id="information-fallback"><h2>Project information</h2><p>Keep equivalent information available before enhancement.</p></section>
<dialog id="information" aria-labelledby="information-title" hidden>
  <h2 id="information-title">Project information</h2>
  <p>Keep equivalent information available before enhancement.</p>
  <form method="dialog"><button type="submit" value="close" autofocus>Close information</button></form>
</dialog>
<!-- Install application handlers before revealing the modal opener or hiding fallback. See docs/dialog.md. -->
```

[Shared UI setup and scoped lifecycle](enhancement.md). [Native dialog contract and fallback recipe](dialog.md) · [Working example](../examples/patterns.html#modal).

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/dialog/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Divider

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `hr; decorative CSS border`.

Use hr for a thematic break and CSS for presentation-only boundaries.

**Acceptance work:** Meaning in reading order, contrast where essential, and forced-colors visibility.

```html
<p>First topic.</p>
<hr>
<p>Next topic.</p>
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/divider/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Drawer

**Planned · Phase 2.** UI route: `ui-drawer with dialog (proposed)`.

Define modal and non-modal modes separately; modal drawer builds on native dialog.

**Acceptance work:** Escape, focus trapping only in modal mode, return focus, edge placement in RTL, and reduced motion.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/drawer/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Page

**Foundation · Phase 1.** UI route: `ui-sidebar, ui-stack, and native landmarks`.

Compose header/nav/main/aside/footer; existing primitives supply arrangement without implied landmarks.

**Acceptance work:** Skip link, one main landmark, responsive reading order, long navigation, and print.

```html
<ui-sidebar>
  <nav aria-label="Project"><ul><li><a href="/projects">Projects</a></li></ul></nav>
  <main><h1>Project</h1><p>Project content.</p></main>
</ui-sidebar>
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/page/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Scroller

**Foundation · Phase 1.** UI route: `labelled .table-scroll region`.

Current baseline wraps wide tables with an explicitly named focusable region; general scrolling affordances remain planned.

**Acceptance work:** Keyboard scrolling, visible overflow cues, 320px reflow, focus outline, and touch.

```html
<div class="table-scroll" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-labelledby="report-title">
  <table><caption id="report-title">Project report</caption>
    <tr><th scope="col">Project</th><th scope="col">Stage</th></tr>
    <tr><td>Field guide</td><td>Planning</td></tr>
  </table>
</div>
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/scroller/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Split Panel

**Planned · Phase 4.** UI route: `ui-split-panel (proposed)`.

Use a keyboard-operable separator with labelled controlled panes and resilient static-layout fallback.

**Acceptance work:** Arrow resizing, min/max, aria-valuenow, collapse/restore, RTL, touch, and persistence ownership.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/split-panel/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

## Navigation

### Breadcrumb

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `nav with ol and aria-current`.

Use a named navigation landmark and ordered destination links; final location is clearly current.

**Acceptance work:** Current-page announcement, truncation alternatives, long labels, and separators hidden from assistive technology.

```html
<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">
  <ol><li><a href="/">Home</a></li><li aria-current="page">Projects</li></ol>
</nav>
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/breadcrumb/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Breadcrumb Item

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `li containing a or current text`.

Each item remains a real list item and destination or current-page text.

**Acceptance work:** Correct href, unique link purpose, and aria-current on one current location.

```html
<li><a href="/projects">Projects</a></li>
<!-- Place inside the breadcrumb ol. -->
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/breadcrumb-item/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Pagination

**Foundation · Phase 2.** UI route: `ui-pagination around a named native nav and list of links`.

CSS-only composition of a named native navigation list and real page URLs. Native current-page state, boundary omissions and wrapping; applications own result counts, routing, loading and focus after updates. See docs/pagination.md.

**Acceptance work:** Verify real destination navigation, current-page uniqueness, previous/next boundaries, plain-text ellipses, native focus/keyboard ownership and no-script navigation. Focused evidence and remaining platform checks are recorded in ACCESSIBILITY.md.

[Pagination guide](pagination.md) · [Specification](specs/pagination.md) · [Focused checks](../tests/pagination.html). Experimental; manual/platform release evidence remains open.

[Component specification](specs/pagination.md)

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/pagination/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Stepper

**Foundation · Phase 2.** UI route: `ui-steps around a native ordered list`.

CSS-only ordered task stages. Author current location with aria-current=step and completed/error/future status as visible text. Real links only for reachable stages; applications own validation, persistence, progression and focus. See docs/stepper.md.

**Acceptance work:** Verify native order/numbering, current/completed/error text, reachable real URLs, no-script task-heading navigation, native form ownership, nested lists and narrow RTL/zoomed-text layouts. Dated evidence and open platform release work are in ACCESSIBILITY.md.

[Stepper guide](stepper.md) · [Specification](specs/stepper.md) · [Focused checks](../tests/stepper.html). Experimental; manual/platform evidence remains open.

[Component specification](specs/stepper.md)

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/stepper/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Step

**Foundation · Phase 2.** UI route: `native li inside ui-steps > ol`.

CSS-only ordered task stages. Author current location with aria-current=step and completed/error/future status as visible text. Real links only for reachable stages; applications own validation, persistence, progression and focus. See docs/stepper.md.

**Acceptance work:** Verify native order/numbering, current/completed/error text, reachable real URLs, no-script task-heading navigation, native form ownership, nested lists and narrow RTL/zoomed-text layouts. Dated evidence and open platform release work are in ACCESSIBILITY.md.

[Stepper guide](stepper.md) · [Specification](specs/stepper.md) · [Focused checks](../tests/stepper.html). Experimental; manual/platform evidence remains open.

[Component specification](specs/stepper.md)

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/step/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Tab Group

**Foundation · Phase 2.** UI route: `ui-tabs around native nav and section panels`.

Experimental ui-tabs enhancement of linked sections with a named native nav and sibling section panels through js/ui.js, opted into by element name without a data-ui marker. Manual activation by default, optional eager automatic activation and horizontal/vertical navigation; see docs/tabs.md.

**Acceptance work:** Focused Tabs checks cover selection, keyboard ownership, fragments, nested form-error reveal, lifecycle and reflow. Real platform, assistive-technology, print and mobile/touch release evidence remains open; see ACCESSIBILITY.md.

[Tabs guide](tabs.md) · [Specification](specs/tabs.md) · [Focused checks](../tests/tabs.html). Experimental; manual/platform release evidence remains open.

[Component specification](specs/tabs.md)

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/tab-group/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Tab

**Foundation · Phase 2.** UI route: `native anchor enhanced within ui-tabs`.

Native fragment anchor enhanced with tab semantics, roving focus, activation and orientation/RTL keyboard behavior. Modified links remain native; see docs/tabs.md.

**Acceptance work:** Focused Tabs checks cover selection, keyboard ownership, fragments, nested form-error reveal, lifecycle and reflow. Real platform, assistive-technology, print and mobile/touch release evidence remains open; see ACCESSIBILITY.md.

[Tabs guide](tabs.md) · [Specification](specs/tabs.md) · [Focused checks](../tests/tabs.html). Experimental; manual/platform release evidence remains open.

[Component specification](specs/tabs.md)

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/tab/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Tab Panel

**Foundation · Phase 2.** UI route: `section inside ui-tabs`.

Authored section remains readable without scripts. Enhanced inactive panels leave the focus order; fragment and form-error reveal preserve native control values. See docs/tabs.md.

**Acceptance work:** Focused Tabs checks cover selection, keyboard ownership, fragments, nested form-error reveal, lifecycle and reflow. Real platform, assistive-technology, print and mobile/touch release evidence remains open; see ACCESSIBILITY.md.

[Tabs guide](tabs.md) · [Specification](specs/tabs.md) · [Focused checks](../tests/tabs.html). Experimental; manual/platform release evidence remains open.

### Tree

**Planned · Phase 3.** UI route: `ui-tree around nested list (proposed)`.

Reserve explorer semantics for actual hierarchical selection; ordinary navigation stays a disclosure list.

**Acceptance work:** Visible-node arrows, Home/End, typeahead, single selection, expansion versus activation, and dynamic removal.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/tree/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Tree Item

**Planned · Phase 3.** UI route: `li with native actions inside ui-tree (proposed)`.

Only branches expand; focused, selected, and activated states remain distinct.

**Acceptance work:** Parent/child relationships, level/position when needed, leaf semantics, and labelled action access.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/tree-item/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

## Feedback

### Badge

**Planned · Phase 2.** UI route: `ui-badge (proposed)`.

Use readable status/count text; appearance is secondary and does not imply a live announcement.

**Acceptance work:** Non-color meaning, contrast, adjacent naming, and large/localized counts.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/badge/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Callout

**Planned · Phase 2.** UI route: `ui-callout with native content (proposed)`.

Persistent inline information with visible heading; use live roles only for newly occurring messages.

**Acceptance work:** Heading/link purpose, status text, optional dismissal, focus after removal, and announcement restraint.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/callout/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Progress Bar

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `progress with label`.

Use value/max for measurable progress and omit value for indeterminate work.

**Acceptance work:** Accessible name, actual value, completion/failure text, and announcement throttling.

```html
<label for="upload">Upload progress</label>
<progress id="upload" value="40" max="100">40%</progress>
```

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/progress-bar/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Progress Ring

**Planned · Phase 2.** UI route: `ui-progress-ring around progress (proposed)`.

Keep one semantic native progress control and add a visual ring without duplicate announcements.

**Acceptance work:** Determinate/indeterminate, textual value, forced colors, reduced motion, and no duplicate progress roles.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/progress-ring/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Skeleton

**Planned · Phase 2.** UI route: `ui-skeleton (proposed)`.

Decorative placeholder accompanies one named busy content region; avoid hiding actual loaded content.

**Acceptance work:** aria-hidden placeholder, aria-busy lifecycle, stable geometry, reduced motion, and failure exit.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/skeleton/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Spinner

**Planned · Phase 2.** UI route: `ui-spinner with status text (proposed)`.

Expose concise loading text once; animation must not be the only indication.

**Acceptance work:** Reduced motion, duplicate announcement prevention, stuck/error state, and label visibility.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/spinner/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Tag

**Planned · Phase 2.** UI route: `ui-tag with optional native remove button (proposed)`.

Readable category/selection text with explicit action when removable; no implied button role on static tags.

**Acceptance work:** Remove name includes the tag, focus after removal, long text, and state contrast.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/tag/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Toast

**Planned · Phase 2.** UI route: `ui-toasts (proposed)`.

Use one notification region; actionable or important messages persist and also have durable context.

**Acceptance work:** Announcement queue, no focus theft, pause/dismiss policy, reduced motion, and visible history for important results.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/toast/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Toast Item

**Planned · Phase 2.** UI route: `native content and button in ui-toasts (proposed)`.

Keep concise text and clearly named actions; automatic dismissal is not the sole delivery of important information.

**Acceptance work:** Live politeness, repeated messages, dismissal focus, and async action failure.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/toast-item/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Tooltip

**Planned · Phase 2.** UI route: `ui-tooltip (proposed)`.

Use for supplemental non-interactive descriptions; essential help remains visible and interactive content uses a popover.

**Acceptance work:** Keyboard focus, Escape, hoverable/persistent content, touch alternative, and aria-describedby ownership.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/tooltip/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

## Media

### Animated Image

**Planned · Phase 4.** UI route: `ui-animated-image (proposed)`.

Supply still image fallback and an explicit play/pause control; avoid unsolicited motion.

**Acceptance work:** Alt text, reduced-motion default, pause state, keyboard activation, and loading failure.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/animated-image/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Avatar

**Planned · Phase 2.** UI route: `ui-avatar around img/text (proposed)`.

Support an image or readable initials; repeated adjacent names may make the image decorative.

**Acceptance work:** Meaningful alt policy, initials fallback, image failure, and no color-only identity.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/avatar/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Carousel

**Planned · Phase 4.** UI route: `ui-carousel around list (proposed)`.

Readable list is the baseline. Start without autoplay and keep all slide destinations available.

**Acceptance work:** Keyboard controls, slide names, focus stability, hidden-slide focus, swipe alternatives, and reduced motion.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/carousel/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Carousel Item

**Planned · Phase 4.** UI route: `li/section inside ui-carousel (proposed)`.

Keep a slide heading and semantic content; visibility is enhancement-owned.

**Acceptance work:** Accessible position, active state, focus after removal, and media pause when hidden.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/carousel-item/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Comparison

**Planned · Phase 4.** UI route: `ui-comparison around two figures (proposed)`.

Present both labelled originals before enhancement and retain separate links to each image.

**Acceptance work:** Keyboard range control, before/after descriptions, touch, zoom, and non-visual comparison text.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/comparison/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Icon

**Planned · Phase 2.** UI route: `ui-icon around inline svg (proposed)`.

Use a curated SVG contract; icons are decorative unless they independently carry meaning.

**Acceptance work:** Decorative aria-hidden, meaningful accessible name, currentColor, forced colors, and visible labels for unfamiliar actions.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/icon/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Markdown

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-markdown (optional, proposed)`.

Prefer build/server rendering; optional client parser must define sanitized output and safe URL policy.

**Acceptance work:** Unsafe HTML/URLs, semantic headings, code escaping, fetch failure if supported, and dependency review.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/markdown/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### QR Code

**Planned · Phase 4.** UI route: `ui-qr-code (optional, proposed)`.

Render a code alongside its readable destination; scanning is never the only route.

**Acceptance work:** Destination link, accessible label, contrast, export, encoding failure, and external-library budget.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/qr-code/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Video

**Native recipe · Phase 4.** UI route: `video with controls plus transcript`.

Native player is the baseline; verified captions, transcript, and necessary descriptions are required before publishing a complete media example.

**Acceptance work:** Keyboard playback, captions, transcript link, no autoplay, and platform control testing; legacy assets are not yet verified.

```html
<video controls aria-label="Coastal walk">
  <source src="coast.mp4" type="video/mp4">
  <track kind="captions" src="coast.en.vtt" srclang="en" label="English" default>
</video>
<p><a href="coast-transcript.html">Read the transcript</a></p>
<!-- Supply verified media, captions and transcript; these filenames are illustrative. -->
```

Illustrative structure only: media assets and captions must be supplied and verified.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/video/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Video Playlist

**Planned · Phase 4.** UI route: `ui-video-playlist (proposed)`.

Compose one native player with an ordered list of linked, labelled media entries.

**Acceptance work:** Current item, captions per item, ended behavior, no forced autoplay, and failure recovery.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/video-playlist/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Zoomable Frame

**Planned · Phase 4.** UI route: `ui-zoom-frame (proposed)`.

Give embedded content a title and direct link; keep zoom controls outside the embedded document.

**Acceptance work:** Keyboard zoom/pan, reset, escape from interaction mode, cross-origin boundaries, and mobile reflow.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/zoomable-frame/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

## Data visualization

### Bar Chart

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-chart type=bar (optional, proposed)`.

Use a figure and a real data table as source/fallback; bars supplement values.

**Acceptance work:** Category/series labels, zero baseline policy, non-color encoding, table equivalence, and high contrast.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/bar-chart/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Bubble Chart

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-chart type=bubble (optional, proposed)`.

Describe all three dimensions with units and preserve the underlying records in a table.

**Acceptance work:** Size legend, accessible data access, keyboard inspection where interactive, and meaningful summary.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/bubble-chart/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Data Grid

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-data-grid around table (optional, proposed)`.

Ship table sorting/filtering first; only spreadsheet interaction earns the ARIA grid model. Defer virtualization.

**Acceptance work:** Header associations, aria-sort, cell navigation contract, editing escape, selection, and large-data assistive technology tests.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/data-grid/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Doughnut Chart

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-chart type=doughnut (optional, proposed)`.

Keep part/whole totals in a table and visible text; limit categories and provide a comparison alternative.

**Acceptance work:** Labels/totals, non-color identification, small slices, and equivalent table reading order.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/doughnut-chart/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Line Chart

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-chart type=line (optional, proposed)`.

Use labelled temporal/ordered axes, units, textual trend summary, and underlying table.

**Acceptance work:** Missing-value policy, series identification without color, keyboard data access, and reduced motion.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/line-chart/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Pie Chart

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-chart type=pie (optional, proposed)`.

Treat as optional presentation over a part/whole table; prefer bars for close comparisons.

**Acceptance work:** Labels, percentages/totals, color independence, and readable alternative.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/pie-chart/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Polar Area Chart

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-chart type=polar-area (optional, proposed)`.

Require a reason for radial presentation; keep common scale and table values explicit.

**Acceptance work:** Scale explanation, text equivalent, category order, and non-color encodings.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/polar-area-chart/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Radar Chart

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-chart type=radar (optional, proposed)`.

Document normalized axes and keep comparable values available as a table.

**Acceptance work:** Axis/scale labels, overlap handling, series identification, and alternative comparison.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/radar-chart/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Scatter Chart

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-chart type=scatter (optional, proposed)`.

Describe units and relationship; preserve individual values and selected-point context.

**Acceptance work:** Keyboard inspection, dense data strategy, clear axes, and equivalent tabular access.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/scatter-chart/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Sparkline

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-sparkline (optional, proposed)`.

Pair compact trend graphics with a concise textual change summary and data link.

**Acceptance work:** Name, trend meaning, no essential hover-only details, forced colors, and inline sizing.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/sparkline/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Chart / Advanced Usage

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-chart shared adapter (optional, proposed)`.

Choose a rendering dependency only after table-first, theming, and accessibility contracts are proven.

**Acceptance work:** Shared data schema, table parity, resize, teardown, theme updates, and dependency/license review.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/chart/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

## Helpers

### Animation

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-animation (optional, proposed)`.

Use CSS/Web Animations API with an explicit reduced-motion contract; content remains readable without animation.

**Acceptance work:** Cancel/finish lifecycle, no flashing, reduced motion, and motion-independent state changes.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/animation/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Format Bytes

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-format-bytes with text fallback (proposed)`.

Choose explicit byte/bit and decimal/binary units; preserve readable server text.

**Acceptance work:** Locale, unit labels, zero/negative/invalid values, and deterministic updates.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/format-bytes/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Format Date

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-format-date around time (proposed)`.

Keep machine-readable datetime and server-rendered text; use Intl with explicit locale/timezone policy.

**Acceptance work:** Invalid dates, hydration consistency, timezone, locale change, and no layout-dependent meaning.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/format-date/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Format Number

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-format-number with text fallback (proposed)`.

Use Intl with explicit currency/unit options while keeping a readable fallback value.

**Acceptance work:** Locale, rounding, invalid input, currency ambiguity, and stable server/client values.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/format-number/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Include

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-include (optional, proposed)`.

Prefer server includes; optional client loading requires an explicit trusted-origin and sanitization contract.

**Acceptance work:** Loading/failure fallback, duplicate IDs, script execution policy, cancellation, and offline behavior.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/include/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Intersection Observer

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-intersection (optional, proposed)`.

Expose observation only when repeated product needs justify markup; no essential content depends on visibility callbacks.

**Acceptance work:** Unobserve on disconnect, reconnect once, unsupported API fallback, and nested-root ownership.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/intersection-observer/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Mutation Observer

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-mutation (optional, proposed)`.

Keep internal observation private by default; optional declarative adapter must avoid self-triggered loops.

**Acceptance work:** Mutation batching, loop protection, teardown, child ownership, and explicit event detail.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/mutation-observer/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Popover

**Native recipe · Phase 1.** UI route: `native popover and popovertarget`.

Use native auto popover and declarative invokers for optional non-modal information. Capability/target checks retain complete inline help when enhancement is unavailable. See docs/popover.md; content keeps its native semantics. Standard setup is available through js/ui.js and explicit data-ui markup; see docs/enhancement.md.

**Acceptance work:** Browser assertions cover toggle/close, non-modal editing, native target relationships, focus restoration, disabled actions, auto-popover coordination, long-content bounds and missing-support/no-script fallback. Verify real Escape, light dismissal, keyboard traversal, zoom, mobile, forced colors and screen readers; see dated evidence in ACCESSIBILITY.md.

```html
<button id="help-open" type="button" popovertarget="project-help" hidden>Open project help</button>
<div id="help-inline"><h3>Project help</h3><p>Keep the full help available inline before enhancement.</p></div>
<div id="project-help" popover="auto" hidden><h3>Project help</h3><p>Keep the full help available inline before enhancement.</p><button type="button" popovertarget="project-help" popovertargetaction="hide">Close project help</button></div>
<!-- Install the matching capability/target checks before revealing the opener or hiding inline help. See docs/popover.md. -->
```

[Shared UI setup and scoped lifecycle](enhancement.md). [Native popover contract and examples](popover.md) · [Focused checks](../tests/popover.html).

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/popover/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Popup

**Foundation · Phase 2.** UI route: `UIPopup.attach geometry adapter (optional js/popup.js)`.

Experimental measured positioning for one native auto-popover surface and a same-document anchor. Native visibility/dismissal and consumer focus/semantics remain independent; see docs/popup.md. Standard setup is available through js/ui.js and explicit data-ui markup; see docs/enhancement.md.

**Acceptance work:** Verify measured edge collision, clipping, zoom/visual viewport, RTL, nested scrolling/dialogs, inline fallback, resource teardown and authored style preservation. Dated evidence and unresolved platform/assistive-technology checks remain in ACCESSIBILITY.md.

[Shared UI setup and scoped lifecycle](enhancement.md). [Experimental adapter contract](popup.md) · [Specification](specs/popup.md) · [Focused geometry checks](../tests/popup.html).

[Component specification](specs/popup.md)

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/popup/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Random Content

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-random (optional, proposed)`.

Keep nonessential variation deterministic where possible; never randomize required instructions or control order.

**Acceptance work:** Readable fallback, stable hydration, no repeated focus removal, and predictable refresh.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/random-content/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Relative Time

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-relative-time around time (proposed)`.

Retain absolute datetime and readable fallback; relative text must expose an absolute-date alternative.

**Acceptance work:** Locale, future/past boundaries, update scheduling, timezone, and timer cleanup without live-announcement noise.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/relative-time/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)

### Resize Observer

**Planned · Phase 5.** UI route: `ui-resize (optional, proposed)`.

Use CSS container queries for layout first; optional adapter handles actual measurement needs.

**Acceptance work:** Feedback-loop protection, teardown/reconnect, batching, and unsupported API fallback.

[Reference component](https://webawesome.com/docs/components/resize-observer/) · [Specification template](component-template.md)
